propositions: Agents prefer cheap available tools (grep/bash) over deferred ones (Serena symbol tools) despite documentation, due to friction asymmetry in discovery and round-trip cost.

The current guidance 'prefer symbol tools over grep' is incomplete: Serena cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) and its index can lag edits, making grep necessary in those cases.
Documentation loaded at session start has negligible salience after six turns in a story; a standing disposition without a triggering moment goes unheeded.
Agents enumerated call sites by hand with grep across multiple turns without invoking Serena, despite explicit guidance in AGENTS.md, demonstrating guidance alone is ineffective.

The solution requires structural changes: re-surface the tool at the moment of action (PreToolUse hook on grep), coach in-band when missed (project-specific criterion and move), remove discovery friction (disable tool search), and correct the guidance with the actual division of labour.
